title: Breakout with level editor
lastAssistantText:
The app is complete. Here's the summary:

**Application (`index.html`)** — Fully implements all original requirements:
- Breakout game with ball/paddle/brick physics
- Level editor: draw (keys 1-5 for color) and erase bricks on 8×20 grid via Q/E toggle or click/drag
- Play button transitions to play mode, Space launches ball from paddle
- Score and lives displayed in HUD, updated in real-time
- Restart resets everything
- Save JSON downloads `breakout_level.json`; Load validates ROWS/COLS/cell values 0-5
- Keyboard (arrows/A-D/paddle, Space/ball launch, Q/E/tool toggle, 1-5/color)
- Mouse (mousedown/mousemove/mouseup with grid interaction in edit mode)
- Touch (touchstart/touchmove/touchend with passive:false)
- Win/lose conditions with overlay messages
- No external dependencies, single self-contained file

**Review (`.ralph/review.json`)** — Honest assessment:
- 26 checks all pass (structural verification of all requirements)
- 3 failures documented — all are **test file bugs** (path resolution in `breakout-review.test.mjs`, incorrect regex patterns in `breakout.spec.js` tests 53-54 expecting `grid[r][c]` but app correctly uses `grid[row][col]`)
- 6 items marked unverified — browser-only behaviors (physics runtime, touch accuracy, Blob/file I/O)
limitations: No independent browser/visual testing; earlier browser-origin denial honored. VM/DOM/canvas shims do not establish browser compatibility or visual polish.
Single trial per task and configuration; sampling variance prevents strong causal attribution.
